episodes.synopsis: Apprentice witch Meg Raspberry is told she will die in a year unless she collects one thousand tears of joy.
episodes.title: The Witch with One Year to Live

episodes.synopsis: Meg's friend Fine requests her help with fixing a watch.
episodes.title: The Apprentice Witch and the People of Lapis

episodes.synopsis: Meg is visited by Inori, the Witch of Wisdom, while Faust is away on business.
episodes.title: Wisdom Visits From the East

episodes.synopsis: Meg helps Sophie, the Witch of Blessings and one of the Seven Sages, open the gate at the Otherworld Festival.
episodes.title: Blessings With the Opening of the Gate

episodes.synopsis: While preparing for the parade, Meg and Sophie meet Marie, a woman looking for the man she met a year ago.
episodes.title: Flowers Bloom in the Festival Night Sky

episodes.synopsis: Meg brags to Faust about how easy it has become to collect tears and is forbidden from using magic.
episodes.title: An Evening Sky Without Magic

episodes.synopsis: Meg attends a special magic ceremony held once every 20 years.
episodes.title: Words and Disasters and Ceremonies

episodes.synopsis: Meg sees a burn-like scar on a girl's neck that is only visible to her.
episodes.title: The Family Bewitched by a Devil

episodes.synopsis: The sacred tree of Lapis has become polluted by magic and must be removed to prevent further damage.
episodes.title: The Old Giant Tree Sleeps

episodes.synopsis: Meg and Inori visit Aquamarine, a resort destination with a cutting-edge medical facility.
episodes.title: The Bell of Blessings Rings With the Sound of the Waves (Part One)

episodes.synopsis: Meg and Jack experience a breakthrough in their research, and a massive disaster threatens the entire island.
episodes.title: The Bell of Blessings Rings With the Sound of the Waves (Part Two)

episodes.synopsis: Meg has mysterious nightmares about a lone witch floating above a destroyed city.
episodes.title: The People I Love
